title: New high-rate shulker farm announced
summary: A new shulker farm with high rates, XP support and a supercharged mechanic was announced.
description: TheySix previewed an upcoming shulker farm while also asking viewers for feedback about YouTube notifications.

body.text: The upcoming design targeted around 4,500 items per hour, supported XP collection and used a mechanic intended to significantly improve farm speed.
Viewers were asked whether channel notifications were reaching them after a noticeable change in returning viewers.
